game.name: Dead Rising 2 (World)(En,Ja,Fr,Es,It,Ko)
game.desc: Dead Rising 2 on Xbox 360 is a bloody and offbeat beat'em all where you play as one of the few survivors of Fortune City, the city where the events take place. You must help Chuck survive the zombie hordes that haunt the streets with the help of a multitude of items ranging from classic guns to the totally crazy items that made the first opus famous.
game.genre: Beat'em Up, Adventure / Survival Horror, Adventure
